about: Output of the legacy SQL function dbo.GetHargaObatNew_WithStok, run read-only on 13 November 2026 with (price group, 'xx', KTP 1, item, CustomerKerjasamaID 0, '', 0) by legacy-drug-prices.sql. Master values and prices only, no patient data. Gradings are the SIMmGradingHargaObat rows for KTP 1 and TipePelayanan STANDARD; grading_group null would mean the legacy ALL rows (none in these sources).
Every case is fed to the pure price rule with conversion 1. A case must give legacy_price unless it is listed in expected_differences, which states the price our rule gives and why.

seroja.database: Klinik Seroja (copy on the Penta dev server)

reasons.seroja-no-rounding: The Seroja copy of the function inserts @HargaObat without round(), so its prices keep the fraction of base x (1 + markup / 100). Kuta 1 and Penta round to whole rupiah; ours rounds to whole rupiah half away from zero, like them.
reasons.seroja-item-class: The Seroja copy also requires SIMmGradingHargaObat.KelasBarangID = mBarang.Kelas_ID. Grading groups and item classes align one to one except this XX item of class 7, which the legacy function therefore prices at 0 %. Ours has no item class and applies the XX rows.

not_carried.reason: Decision 6: no service-type dimension now. No case exercises it.

not_carried.rule: Guarantor contracts: CustomerKerjasamaID, ObatUp, guarantor category CC108 "MA", HargaObatDigunakan
not_carried.reason: They depend on hard-coded ids in the legacy function. The oracle passed CustomerKerjasamaID 0, so no case exercises them.

not_carried.rule: BPJS + Fornas items at base price
not_carried.reason: A BPJS grading row of 0 % expresses it as data. No source has a Fornas item (Penta 0 of 3.505).
Depends on a hard-coded class; not carried. No case exercises it.
Decision 5: local and foreign are price groups. The oracle used KTP 1 and the gradings are the KTP 1 rows.

unit_conversion.about: Legacy never sold in a unit other than the stock unit. Ours rounds once after multiplying by the unit content (BC ConvertAmountByUnitOfMeasure), so a STRIP of 10 is not 10 x the rounded tablet price.
